name: Kyoko Nagamine
source:
Likes: playing otome games (even H-games), martial arts, surfing on the Net, talking to herself
Dislikes: dating in real life, hospitals, cooking

The main protagonist of « Another Story », she is the real deal when it comes to play at otome games and capturing the hearts of 2D men. 
She isn't interested in dating people for some reasons from her past.
